findings.claim: The person-build refusal's next tells the seat 'that act closes it, a reply does not' even for the unbound question the fold now asks, for example on a refused work wait.
findings.evidence: intent_work.go:1594-1597 sets next to question show channel:Q with that reason whenever q.ID != "". Since the fold (intent_work.go:1583), act is nil when again is work wait (intent_work.go:1878, :1883-1888, intent_unit_review.go:79-120, intent_answer.go:217) or a target is empty. question ask applies the same next only under q.PersonAct != nil (intent_process.go:1660-1662). At base, this ask's next was question wait with 'wait for the person's answer; only their direct build command bypasses admission'.
findings.change: Apply the question show next and its reason only when act != nil; for an unbound question keep the base's question wait next and reason. Optionally assert r.Next in the subtest 'a refused wait asks an unbound question'.
